recommendations.recommended_action: Conduct a COPD condition-management review and primary-care follow-up to assess symptom control and educate on minimizing exposure to environmental respiratory triggers.
recommendations.next_step: Care coordinator to contact the member to schedule a respiratory clinical review with their primary care clinician.
